newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma firms, bonds hold in late dealings.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma firms, bonds hold in late dealings.

text.p: Greek interbank deposits, forex forwards and bonds were stable in late Monday trade while ecu/drachma was firmer on buying interest, dealers said.
"Depos and swaps are quiet and there are no price fluctuations," a state bank dealer said.
The central bank kept its intervention rate in overnight money unchanged at 11.90 percent. Bonds were also holding steady late on Monday, a foreign bank bond dealer said.
"Bonds are quiet and they show no particular movement or interest," he added.
On Wednesday, Greece will auction 150 billion drachmas of three-year bonds, 100 billion of five-year bonds and 50 billion of seven-year bonds.
Their coupons are set at 9.8, 9.2 and 8.9 percent for three-, five- and seven-year bonds, respectively.

"We were expecting these rates because we were aware of the finance ministry's intentions to apply aggressive interest rate cuts. However, the market's opinions should be given some consideration," a foreign bank dealer said.
The dealer expected prices to be low and yields around 10.30 percent for three-year bonds, 10.00 percent for five-year bonds and 9.90 percent for seven-year bonds, .
"I do not see much interest on the part of either foreign or institutional investors for the auction," the dealer said.
The mark was quoted at 157.95/05 drachmas from Monday's 157.940 fix, the dollar at 266.60/70 drachmas from 266.270 and the Ecu at 306.00/10 from 305.900 drachmas.

"Ecu/drachma is trading higher at 306.05-15. It had traded between the range of 305.45-306.23 since this morning. After the fixing, we had buyers of ecus for drachmas," a foreign forex bank dealer said.
The continuing crisis in neigbouring Albania seems to have hit the drachma, the dealer said.
The National Bank of Greece, the domestic money market's biggest player, quoted the following late rates:
** Overnight at 11.40-11.90
** One week at 11.40-11.90
** Two weeks at 11.40-11.90
** Three weeks at 11.40-11.90
** One month at 11.35-11.85
** Two months at 11.30-11.80
** Three months at 11.25-11.75
** Six months at 11.05-11.55
** Nine months at 10.90-11.40
** Twelve months at 10.75-11.25
